model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, released checkpoint, 48 shards, 510.3 GB, fp8 dense + fp4 experts, no conversion
command: per arm: make -C c deepseek_v41 VK=1, then COLI_VULKAN=1 ./c/coli serve --model <checkpoint> --ram 28 --ctx 8192 --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8010; one warmup turn discarded, then 3 measured turns of POST /v1/chat/completions (stream, max_tokens 96, temperature 0.6, prompt 'Describe the nature of a transformer.'), decode tok/s = (tokens-1)/(last-first chunk time); the arms ran in separate trees from identical builds one commit apart (baseline 1d10bbf1 = origin/dev, trial 9cfa502f), serve stopped between arms

hardware.cpu: Intel Core i9-12900K, container cpuset of 18 logical CPUs visible to the engine
hardware.storage: single NVMe (nvme0n1), f2fs, the only drive the checkpoint streams from; expert reads measured at 2.6-2.7 GB/s in both arms
hardware.os: Arch Linux, kernel 7.1.11-arch1-1, gcc 16.2.1, -O3 -march=native -fopenmp, RADV (Vulkan 1.4.354) on AMD Radeon RX 6900 XT 16 GiB with Resizable BAR

hypothesis: Placing the dense trunk on the device before the mapped-weights window is asked — instead of after a 9/10-heap window ask that starves the chain fit — and dropping the tier's GTT host-pool mirror beside it raises decode throughput on a single-NVME ReBAR card, because the trunk stops taking the CPU's threads for its matmuls and the RAM the mirror held returns to the expert cache.

config.COLI_VK_PLACEMENT: window-first, tier host pool on (origin/dev default)

quality.method: make check: 3018 tests, 0 failures (392 skipped); every benchmark turn completed with coherent text at temperature 0.6 (text hashes recorded per turn in the raw evidence); placement state verified in the serve log: chain 0 of 40 layers on the device, tier host pool on

config.COLI_VK_PLACEMENT: trunk-first, tier host pool off beside the trunk (this PR)

quality.method: make check: 3018 tests, 0 failures (392 skipped); every benchmark turn completed with coherent text at temperature 0.6 (text hashes recorded per turn in the raw evidence); placement state verified in the serve log: chain 40 of 40 layers on the device, window asked 5 GiB (heap less trunk less 1 GiB reserve), host pool off, no staged path
